summary.title: Guests are saying
summary.value: Elmer's washable glue sticks are a favorite among guests for school projects and crafts, praised for their strong adhesion to paper and cardboard without mess. The disappearing purple color is a fun feature that helps kids see where they've applied glue, making it ideal for young artists. Guests appreciate the washable formula, ease of use, and the convenience of the size, making it a staple for home and school activities.

product_description.downstream_description: Purple on contact yet drying clear, Elmer’s Disappearing Purple School Glue Sticks help you see exactly where you’re sticking your charts, pictures and more! The glue stick applies smoothly with a disappearing purple formula, making it perfect for kids just learning how to glue. Add on its non-toxic, acid-free formula and you can see why it’s the ideal adhesive for classrooms, homes and youngsters.
